acceptance_state_machine.crypto_submit_result_2: 0x889C2(...,0x202) uses B6 record +0x2E limit2 for CryptoIf submit/busy retries of the current authentication candidate; B4->C3 preserves that counter across busy retries, while 0x8891E resets it when advancing to a new auth/freshness attempt

freshness_commit.failure_action: no copy; committed B6 freshness is unchanged
freshness_commit.success_action: copy pending 12-byte B6 slot 0xfebe54ec -> committed slot 0xfebe54d4

freshness_results.0x22: hard freshness failure -> A5 -> cleanup; no command7 and no delivery
freshness_results.0x23: 0x8891E(...,0x201) candidate retry; if below B6 limit1, C3->B4 and auth-candidate counter increments
freshness_results.0x24: call freshness-boundary callback through 0x88908; state remains C3 and command7 still executes

acceptance_state_machine.gate1: 0x88C9C reaches post-CMAC gate only when 0x88A56 returns 0

gate2.mismatch: result!=0: freshness commit callback receives 0x00010002 so pending state does not commit; 0x8891E(...,0x200) may retry the same queued PDU; no PDU42 delivery on mismatch
gate2.success: result==0: freshness commit callback receives freshness ID2 with high16 clear, pending slot commits, then PDU42 routes to COM

acceptance_state_machine.new_pdu_transition: 0x88702: D2->C3 and resets auth-candidate + CryptoIf-submit retry counters to zero

authentication_candidate_or_mac_mismatch.interaction: 0x8891E increments this counter and resets the CryptoIf-submit counter before B4 retry

cryptoif_submit_busy.interaction: 0x889C2 increments it on driver result2; 0x8891E clears it when an auth/freshness retry is scheduled
cryptoif_submit_busy.scope: current authentication candidate/verification attempt within the queued PDU

acceptance_state_machine.same_pdu_retry_transition: 0x88702 itself performs B4->C3 without an additional reset; the caller that schedules an authentication retry (0x8891E) has already incremented the auth counter and reset the CryptoIf-submit counter to zero

verified_delivery.length_boundary: The recovered queue/delivery path preserves a PduInfo length and PDU42's COM descriptor is 32 bytes. Static evidence does not prove that B28..B31 are physically stripped before COM RAM; the application-consumer census, not a stripping assumption, is the basis for classifying them as SecOC-only.

application_consumer.downstream: raw delta and capped effective gap are stored at GP+0xA4A/GP+0xA4C; CB4F4 consumes the capped gap in target plausibility/supervision

application_sequence_relation.relationship: signal261 is ordinary authenticated application data inside B0..B27. SecOC freshness is reconstructed from B28[7:4] plus SecOC RAM state. Signal261 is unpacked/consumed only on the post-verification COM/application side and does not select the SecOC freshness candidate.
application_sequence_relation.sender_requirement: Maintain both counters: a SecOC message8/reset/trip state for CMAC/FV4 and the independent application signal261 modulo-64 sequence for steering plausibility.

authenticated_envelope.result_evidence: live 0x88C16 tests result!=0 as mismatch; disabled 0x62430 command7 KAT initializes result=1 and reports pass only when result becomes 0
authenticated_envelope.result_polarity: command7 result byte 0 means verified/match; nonzero means mismatch
authenticated_envelope.submit_path: 0x88A56 -> 0x88986 -> CryptoIf job0 -> driver dispatch -> command7 prepare 0x822D0 -> ICU-S command7 0x83BF4
authenticated_envelope.trailer: B28[3:0] || B29 || B30 || B31 after FV4 removal/top-alignment

cross_variant.boundary: H and F application bytes are identical for every record/config/function used by this proof. This does not transfer low-region calibration values or identify the upstream sender.

evidence_boundary: This closes the H/F EPS receiver-side SecOC verification algorithm for protected 0x0B6, including exact freshness state, candidate/window rules, retry scopes, CMAC input/slot selection, commit timing, and application-sequence separation. It does not recover the protected slot-4 secret, sender-side ownership of live freshness state, stock sender cadence, or the upstream FRC/Brake payload/signing producer.

epoch_transition.not_newer_rule: older/equal candidate returns 0x23 while reset trial index <=3, otherwise 0x22
epoch_transition.staging: accepted/reconstructed candidate is copied to B6 pending slot 0xfebe54ec before CMAC
epoch_transition.strictly_newer_rule: global_trip > committed_trip OR (global_trip == committed_trip AND candidate_reset > committed_reset)

message_reconstruction_same_epoch.overflow_behavior: If the next congruent value would exceed 0xFF, the candidate message is forced to 0xFF and outer 0x89E9A returns status 0x24. The same 0xFF/status0x24 boundary is also reached when the selected reset is already 0xFFFFF.

reset_candidate_search.important_ambiguity: Only current-2 and current+2 collide in the two-bit transmitted reset domain; attempt0 chooses -2 (trial3) and the one allowed same-PDU retry can choose +2 (trial4).
reset_candidate_search.selection: authentication_candidate_retry_counter selects the Nth matching trial

special_status_0x24.meaning: message-0xFF or reset-0xFFFFF boundary candidate notification
special_status_0x24.reason: 0x88A56 calls 0x88908 then reaches the common C3 path that builds/submits command 7; unlike 0x23 it does not transition C3->B4.

trip_wrap.post_verified_sync_action: 0x8A130 commits pending global trip/reset; on wrap it calls 0x8A0AE(0), which clears current+pending ordinary freshness slots whose internal record+0x04 linkage field equals 0, including D7 and B6
trip_wrap.wrap_acceptance: when current trip >= 0xFFFF-15, a nonzero new trip <=16 is treated as forward wrap by 0x89F6E

identifiers.boundary: The authenticated prefix is the 16-bit DataID 0x00B6. Freshness ID2 selects receiver state but is not separately concatenated into the 36-byte CMAC input. No additional source/profile identifier was recovered in that input.

initialization.freshness: 0x00089812 zeros current/pending global sync state and both 12-byte ordinary current/pending slots
initialization.persistence_boundary: This proves application initialization writes these RAM cells; it does not by itself claim a whole-program negative for every possible external/NvM restoration path.
initialization.verify_engine: 0x0008857C clears both retry counters and initializes all three queue states to E1

sender_recipe.cryptographic_blocker: The exact receiver selector is closed, but the slot-4 secret value remains opaque to mapped CPU/application code. A sender still needs that secret or an approved/available ICU-S operation that can produce the required tag.
receiver_required_steps: Maintain a full freshness tuple consistent with the receiver's authenticated 0x00F trip/reset epoch and B6 message8 progression.
Encode FV4 in B28[7:4] as message_low2||reset_low2.
Compute AES-CMAC-128 over 00 B6 || B0..B27 || freshness48 using the key selected by protected ICU-S slot4.
Independently maintain application signal261 in B7[5:0] for steering sequence/plausibility semantics.
sender_recipe.runtime_state_blocker: The receiver algorithm is closed, but sender ownership/source of the live trip/reset/message state and stock wall-clock cadence remain outside this EPS receiver image.

sienna_prior_art.boundary: Sienna supplies role anchors for the generic acceptance engine. The H functions occupy the same control roles near a +0x5A64 Sienna relocation but are not claimed byte-identical: raw differences include relocated calls, GP/table displacements, and generated-profile geometry. H freshness/window conclusions below must be recovered from the target-native H bodies rather than transferred from Sienna.

static_conclusion.short_form: FV4 reconstructs against authenticated 00F state; candidate is staged, command7 verifies CMAC28 with slot4, and only result0 commits freshness then delivers PDU42.
